title: Piburger See Oetz
highlights: One of Tyrol's warmest bathing lakes nestled in a protected landscape area
Romantic forest setting high above the village of Oetz
Nature educational trail and scenic circular hiking path
Bathing facility with rowboat rental and traditional lakeside restaurant
kurzbeschreibung: Piburger See above Oetz is one of the warmest swimming lakes in Tirol, boasting an idyllic woodland setting.
beschreibung:
Natural Idyll in the Front Ötztal

The Piburger See is a sparkling jewel in the Ötztal. Nestled in a protected forest area at an altitude of 913 metres above sea level, the lake was formed after a post-glacial rockslide. Thanks to its sheltered basin location, the water warms up to 24 degrees Celsius in midsummer, making it one of the region's most popular swimming lakes.

Recreation in the Protected Landscape Area

A shaded walking trail loops around the lake through ancient coniferous woods, past scenic viewpoints overlooking the glistening waters. The historic bathing establishment features sunbathing lawns, rowing boat hire, and a lakeside restaurant where guests can savour freshly caught trout and Tyrolean delicacies with lake views.
